verses: Rent is the basket at the dam, Where bream and kuan abound; As useless is the prince of Lu, In vigor wanting found. Ch'i's daughter now to Chi comes back, Her followers as a cloud; Her son should hold her fast in Lu, Her wickedness to shroud.

Rent is the basket at the dam, Where bream and tench abound; As useless is the prince of Lu, In vigor wanting found. Back comes Ch'i's daughter, with a shower Of followers at her side, Her son should hold her fast in Lu, Her wanton ways to hide.

Rent is the basket at the dam; Fish in and out can go; As useless is the prince of Lu, And vigor fails to show. Back comes Ch'i's daughter, with a stream Of followers behind; Her son should hold her fast in Lu, From such lewd ways confined.
